entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The exit is right there!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Who is it!? What the—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Talk about bullshit clothes! First a king,[n]now some kinda shogun!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Welcome to the museum of the master[n]artist Madarame...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Sensei? Is that you?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That attire...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Disgusting.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This... This is all one big lie, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: My usual ragged attire is nothing but[n]an act.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Besides, a famous person living in that[n]shack? I have another home... under[n]a mistress's name, of course.
This is absurd.
Some setup you've got.
I'm almost impressed.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Hahaha! How naïve!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Hahaha! Don't make me laugh.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Hmph. Such insincerity.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If the "Sayuri" was stolen, why was it[n]in the storage room? And if you had[n]the real one, why make copies!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If it's really you, Sensei... please tell me!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Foolish child. You still don't see?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: The painting being stolen was just a false[n]rumor I spread! It was all a perfectly[n]calculated staging!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What do you mean!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Let me see... How does this sound?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: "I found the real painting, but it can't[n]go public... You can have it for a special[n]price, though..."

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Haha! How's that for preferential[n]treatment!? Art snobs'll eat it up,[n]and pay good cash at that!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: The value of art is purely illusion.[n]What's the matter with providing that[n]illusion to eager customers?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Though I doubt a brat like you would ever[n]come up with such a brilliant scheme!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You keep goin' on and on about[n]money this, money that...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: No wonder you ended up with this[n]disgusting museum!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're supposed to be an artist, right!?[n]Aren't you ashamed of plagiarizing other[n]people's work!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Art is nothing but a tool... A tool to gain[n]money and fame!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: You helped me greatly as well, Yusuke...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: God... Pisses me off... That's your teacher.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But what about the people who believe[n]in you? Who think you're a master artist!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: ...I'll tell you this alone, Yusuke.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: If you wish to succeed in this world,[n]I'd advise you don't rise against me.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Do you believe anyone could find success[n]with my objection holding them down?[n]Hahahahaha!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To think I was under the care of this[n]wretched man!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: You thought I took you in out of the[n]goodness in my heart?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Plucking talented, yet troubled artists[n]allows me to find promising pupils and[n]take their ideas...

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: After all, it's much easier to steal[n]the futures of children who can't[n]fight back.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I can't believe this...

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Livestock are killed for their hide and meat![n]This is no different, you fool!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: ...But I tire of this little chat. It's time[n]that I—

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You are unforgivable.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Hm?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It doesn't matter who you are...[n]I won't forgive you!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: So, you repay my keeping you around[n]for all these years with ingratitude?[n]You damn brat!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Men! Dispose of these thieves!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Get back!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: How amusing...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems the truth is stranger than[n]fiction, hm?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Kitagawa-kun!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I wanted to believe it wasn't true...[n]I had clouded my vision for so long...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My eyes were truly blind... Blind, and[n]unable to see the true self behind this[n]one horrible man!
